'''Daksh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He engaged a Republic strike team and was easily defeated.
